name: 罗马神话
prompt: Create one 16:9 horizontal museum-style illustration of Roman mythology by conservatively widening the attached panorama. Preserve its overall cinematic, finely painted style, palette, layered mountains/city/sea, and all principal narrative scenes. Extend the lateral landscape instead of cropping the top or bottom. Keep Aeneas carrying his elderly father from the distant burning city at upper left; the celestial Roman gods with their existing traditional robes and identifying objects across the top; sea voyages, ploughing and city foundations at right; the central protective she-wolf and TWO infant twins; underworld figures at lower left; household shrine, hearth, harvest and pastoral family scenes below; Roman arches, temples, birds and local tools. For the central infant twins, use simple modest linen tunics or swaddling cloth covering their torsos and hips while they sit safely beside the protective she-wolf. Retain the clearly recognizable wolf-and-twins founding legend through this clothed depiction. All other human figures wear modest period clothing; preserve their activities and distinctive faces. This is a dignified mythological museum panorama with no sexual or graphic violent content. Keep original small narrative details and natural anatomy; no new characters, giant text, labels, logo, watermark, panel frames or modern objects. Use subtle oil-painted material and atmospheric depth without a coarse filter; content and meaningful objects stay recognizable.
